$Comment: Elsie the Weaver's own small board: one job a day, drawn at midnight UTC. Hosts names the id Elsie
keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Weaver), so her quest page (in her Christmas conversation and in
her feast conversation's Christmas line) lists the day's job beside her own quests.
The first slot posts the Christmas_Weaver_Skill band, which only her skill job carries
(Mmo_Christmas_Weaver_Skill_Job.json, a server running MMO Skill Tree); the second posts the
Christmas_Weaver_Errand band, her plain errands. The slot gates are read when the board loads: Min 1
leaves a slot off where MMO Skill Tree is missing, Max 0 where it is installed, so every server posts
one job from Elsie a day for the same plain pay. Both slots are Optional, so the one a server leaves
out never reads as a gap. Christmas_Miller_Jobs.json explains the rest; its words are in
